integrity: All statements concern the punctured halved-cube flag complex and its natural inclusion; finite mod-two checks do not replace the unrestricted integral argument.
scientific_limitations: One vertex of the even-parity Hamming scale-two flag complex, n>=4; relies on the published unpunctured Green integral theorem; no higher-scale, multiple-deletion or stabilizer-equivariant result. Independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Vertex-deletion homotopy of halved-cube clique complexes
